intro: Jacksonville listings advertise non-climate 10x10 units from about $49, while typical street rates run about $107 in the city and about $116 across the metro. Asking rents are down sharply year over year as new facilities open, which helps a negotiation — and still is not the six-month cost after the promo ends.
data_asof: Aug–Oct 2026 (StorageCafe, Storage Stats). StorageUnitCosts does not publish a Jacksonville city page.

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Non-climate listings from about $40; climate-controlled promos from about $16. Climate-controlled street rate ~$53.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap). Climate-controlled ~$79.

Most rented size. City average $107, down 1.8% YoY (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Jacksonville metro averages $116, down 14.1% YoY (Storage Stats). StorageUnitCosts tracks 20 large cities and does not publish Jacksonville. Climate-controlled ~$124. Non-climate listings from about $49.
Two-bedroom contents. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$165.
Three-bedroom home or a car. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$217. Non-climate listings from about $70.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Woodland Acres (~$87), Northbank (~$88) and Cedar Hills Estates (~$94) among the cheapest areas, while Spring Glen (~$355) and Southpoint (~$282) run highest.
Jacksonville's all-unit average is lowest around December (~$155) and highest in October (~$159), StorageCafe. The seasonal gap is small next to the year-over-year drop in asking rents.

About 726,000 sq ft of new storage is due in 2026, up 36% from last year, across 10 facilities (StorageCafe). The metro has roughly 10.1 sq ft per person. New buildings often advertise a low move-in rate — ask for the month-5 price before you reserve.
The metro's non-climate 10x10 asking rent is down 14.1% from a year ago (Storage Stats). Quote that when an increase notice arrives.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts city pages, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
